title: Southern Lights, January 23-25, 2026, St. Simons Island, GA — not too late
excerpt: It's not too late to be part of Southern Lights, an annual conference in late January on the Georgia coast, co-hosted by Brian. While on-site lodging is full, there is still room for you in the gathering space and at meals … and there is ample lodging available nearby:…
body:
It's not too late to be part of Southern Lights, an annual conference in late January on the Georgia coast, co-hosted by Brian.

While on-site lodging is full, there is still room for you in the gathering space and at meals … and there is ample lodging available nearby: [https://southernlightsconference.com/faqs](https://southernlightsconference.com/faqs)

You can learn the details and register here: [https://southernlightsconference.com/](https://southernlightsconference.com/)

You can still enjoy meals on site with the Southern Lights community by clicking here: [https://fs21.formsite.com/Epworthssi/kqhvwutzm9/index](https://fs21.formsite.com/Epworthssi/kqhvwutzm9/index).

You can still give Southern Lights as a gift here: [https://southernlightsconference.com/giftcards](https://southernlightsconference.com/giftcards)

You can also live-stream from your own home, or watch recorded sessions on-demand after the event by registering here: [https://www.eventbrite.com/e/southern-lights-conference-2026-registration-1138009349599](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/southern-lights-conference-2026-registration-1138009349599?aff=oddtdtcreator).

This is one of only two public appearances for Brian in 2026.

Learn more here: [https://southernlightsconference.com/](https://southernlightsconference.com/)
